$comment: Hand-curated. Unlike data/monitor-commands.json these are C# methods Renode exposes on emulation objects by reflection, and carry no description in the sources, so the text here is written from the Renode documentation. Keep signatures accurate; prefer adding a method over guessing at one.

methods.name: LoadELF
methods.description: Loads an ELF image into memory and sets the program counter from its entry point.

methods.name: LoadBinary
methods.description: Loads a raw image at an address. Does not set the program counter — set `cpu PC` yourself.

methods.name: LoadHEX
methods.description: Loads an Intel HEX image.

methods.name: LoadFdt
methods.description: Loads a flattened device tree blob at an address.

methods.name: ReadByte
methods.description: Reads 8 bits from the bus.

methods.name: ReadWord
methods.description: Reads 16 bits from the bus.

methods.name: ReadDoubleWord
methods.description: Reads 32 bits from the bus.

methods.name: WriteByte
methods.description: Writes 8 bits to the bus.

methods.name: WriteWord
methods.description: Writes 16 bits to the bus.

methods.name: WriteDoubleWord
methods.description: Writes 32 bits to the bus.

methods.name: Tag
methods.description: Names an address range so accesses to it are reported under that name, optionally returning a fixed value. Useful for regions no peripheral models yet.

methods.name: SilenceRange
methods.description: Suppresses the warnings normally logged for accesses to an unmodelled address range.

methods.name: LogPeripheralAccess
methods.description: Logs every MMIO read and write on a peripheral. The fastest way to see what firmware is actually doing to it.

methods.name: GetSymbolAddress
methods.description: Returns the address of a symbol from the loaded ELF.

methods.name: ApplySVD
methods.description: Loads register names from a CMSIS-SVD file so logs name registers instead of offsets.

methods.name: LoadPlatformDescription
methods.description: Builds the machine's peripherals from a .repl platform description. Additive — layer a board file over an SoC file.

methods.name: LoadPlatformDescriptionFromString
methods.description: Same as LoadPlatformDescription, with the platform fragment given inline instead of in a file.

methods.name: StartGdbServer
methods.description: Exposes the CPU as a remote GDB target on a TCP port.

methods.name: StopGdbServer
methods.description: Stops the GDB server.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the machine.

methods.name: EnableProfiler
methods.description: Writes an execution profile for the machine.

methods.name: CreateServerSocketTerminal
methods.description: Exposes a UART on a raw TCP socket. Pass false as the third argument whenever a program rather than a human reads the socket, or Telnet negotiation bytes corrupt the stream.

methods.name: CreateUartPtyTerminal
methods.description: Exposes a UART as a host pseudo-terminal device.

methods.name: CreateSwitch
methods.description: Creates a virtual network switch that machines can be connected to.

methods.name: CreateTap
methods.description: Bridges the emulation to a host TAP interface.

methods.name: SetGlobalQuantum
methods.description: Sets the virtual-time synchronization quantum. Smaller values tighten cross-peripheral timing and slow the simulation.

methods.name: SetAdvanceImmediately
methods.description: Lets virtual time run ahead of wall-clock time instead of being paced to it.

methods.name: RunFor
methods.description: Runs the emulation for a span of virtual time and then pauses.

methods.name: LoadState
methods.description: Restores a previously saved emulation snapshot.

methods.name: SaveState
methods.description: Saves the whole emulation to a snapshot file.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Wires a peripheral to a host-side endpoint such as a socket terminal, PTY or switch.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Undoes a Connect.

methods.name: PC
methods.description: Reads or sets the program counter.

methods.name: SP
methods.description: Reads or sets the stack pointer.

methods.name: Step
methods.description: Executes a single instruction, or the given number of instructions.

methods.name: ExecutionMode
methods.description: Switches the CPU between free-running and single-stepped execution.

methods.name: PerformanceInMips
methods.description: Sets the CPU's rated speed, which determines how much virtual time each instruction consumes.

methods.name: AddHook
methods.description: Runs a Python snippet whenever execution reaches an address.

methods.name: IsHalted
methods.description: Reads or sets whether the CPU is halted.
